claim: Produces a market research synthesis: decision and scope, source ledger with confidence, competitor comparison, counterevidence, recommendation with disconfirming test, and positioning decision.

baseline.prompt: Write research.md synthesizing what you know about the market for AI coding agents for small teams, who competes, and whether there is room for a new entrant. Give a recommendation.

tasks.description: Fresh-context agent with the full procedure produces the market synthesis elements.
tasks.prompt: Read ./SKILL.md completely, then write research.md for the question: 'Is there room for a new AI coding agent aimed at small teams?' Follow the output format: decision and scope; source ledger (Claim | Source | Accessed | Market/plan | Evidence class | Supports/contradicts | Confidence); competitor and substitute comparison; table stakes/conventions/differentiation; counterevidence and unresolved conflicts; recommendation with risks, confidence, and a disconfirming test; positioning decision (segment/job, alternative, category, differentiator/outcome, proof, fit boundary, message hierarchy, objections, channel handoff).

tasks.description: Fresh-context baseline (no skill): same task, same synthesis oracle.
